tool: Codex CLI (codex exec), model gpt-6-astra, built-in image generation
purpose: The baffled stare he gives the visitor once every removable sticker is peeled off the monitor.

prompts.wtf-day:
Use your built-in image generation tool to edit an animation frame for a layered website illustration.

Attached: day-smile.png is the EDIT TARGET: a seated stylized 3D man on a real alpha-transparent 1536x1024 canvas.

Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit. Make exactly ONE facial change: someone just peeled every sticker off his monitor and he looks up, baffled, straight at the viewer as if to say "wtf?". Turn BOTH pupils and irises to look DIRECTLY AT THE CAMERA (centred, making eye contact with the viewer), RAISE BOTH EYEBROWS very high in disbelief, and give him a flat, unimpressed, slightly open mouth (no smile). CRITICAL INVARIANTS: keep the exact 1536x1024 canvas, transparent background, same man, hair silhouette, head position and size, ears, nose, outfit, complete connected body, hands, fingers, feet and every body pose pixel. Camera perfectly locked, EXACT soft daylight lighting of the input. Change ONLY the eyes, eyebrows and mouth. This frame must register with the original. No new objects, no text. Genuine alpha transparency, preserve the original baked contact shadows.

Save the result as /tmp/wtfgen/day-wtf.png. Reply with just the saved path.
prompts.wtf-night:
Use your built-in image generation tool to edit an animation frame for a layered website illustration.

Attached images:
- night-smile.png: the EDIT TARGET, a seated stylized 3D man lit for NIGHT on a real alpha-transparent 1536x1024 canvas.
- day-wtf.png: the same man in daylight with the target expression.

Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit. Give night-smile.png exactly the facial expression of day-wtf.png: BOTH pupils and irises looking DIRECTLY AT THE CAMERA (eye contact with the viewer), BOTH eyebrows raised very high in disbelief, flat unimpressed slightly open mouth (no smile). CRITICAL INVARIANTS: keep the exact 1536x1024 canvas, transparent background, same man, hair silhouette, head position and size, ears, nose, outfit, complete connected body, hands, fingers, feet and every body pose pixel of night-smile.png. Camera perfectly locked and keep its EXACT night lighting. Change ONLY the eyes, eyebrows and mouth. No new objects, no text. Genuine alpha transparency, preserve the baked contact shadows.

Save the result as /tmp/wtfgen/night-wtf.png. Reply with just the saved path.

postprocessing: Alpha stretched from a 254 maximum to fully opaque; saved under expressions/sources and encoded as WebP (quality 90, alpha 100).
